name: isIPAllowlistEnabled
definition: True when the tool restricts account access to a list of trusted network addresses and the list holds at least one address. False when the list is empty, which means any address can reach the account.
population: the allowed-address entries of one tool account's IP access management; the count is kept, never the addresses
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A successful read of the account's IP allow list showing at least one entry; an error, 401/403 or unrecognised read is Not evaluated. An empty list is a real read of no restriction and is False.
citations: SendGrid API reference, IP Access Management (twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/ip-access-management): GET /v3/access_settings/whitelist

changeLog.change: Registered so the SendGrid email-security transformations can emit it. Meaning written from the public SendGrid API reference and one read of a real account (read-only); no replay-backed validation yet, so the key stays proposed and V0.

notes: Account-level access control, not mail delivery. Read from SendGrid, whose restricted key lists this read under the Security permission.
